current_evidence: The council's live 'Planning application local validation requirements' page links only this 'Validation Checklist - Adopted July 2025' PDF as the local list, and the document text says 'Adopted July 2025'.

issues.detail: Grokbot captured roughly 17 of the 41 numbered local requirements in Section 3. Missing ones (with triggers): 3D Visuals (residential/commercial schemes over 150 dwellings / 7,500 sq m); Active Travel England Assessment Toolkit (150+ dwellings, 7,500 sq m+ or 5 ha+); Affordable Housing Statement (major residential of 15+ dwellings or 0.5 ha+, including specialist/supported housing); Archaeological Assessment (on or adjacent to a heritage asset with archaeological interest); Coal Mining Risk Assessment (built development in Coal Authority High Risk Referral Areas, excluding change of use and reserved matters, plus minerals working); Economic Statement (where economic benefits are used to justify the proposal); External Lighting / Floodlighting with light pollution assessment (floodlighting schemes, or where PEA shows lighting may affect bat roosts/flight paths); Materials (new/altered shopfronts, development in Conservation Areas or affecting Listed Buildings); Operations Statement and Restoration & Aftercare Plan (all minerals applications incl. aggregate depots); Photographs and Photomontages (demolition in/affecting a Conservation Area, Listed Building works incl. internal, major Green Belt development); Planning Statement (all major applications, Green Belt, Sustainable Urban Extensions, departures, LB cases 'in the planning balance'); Sequential Test (main town centre uses outside centres, separate from the 1,000 sq m impact test); Scheme for Site Treatment and Management Plan (all applications including demolition); Social Value Strategy (30+ dwellings, commercial sites 1 ha+ or new commercial buildings 1,000 sq m+); Travel Plan (major traffic-generating non-housing development and smaller schemes near AQMAs); Viability Assessment (where policy requirements incl. affordable housing cannot be met, or enabling development); Volume Calculations (extensions to or redevelopment of PDL in the Green Belt); Waste Assessment (all waste development, need evidence if site not in Waste Local Plan); Housing Delivery Statement (major residential on sites not allocated for housing in the Core Strategy); Children's Home Statement (all new children's homes, with the separate Children's Home Pro Forma linked on the page); Evidence of Self Build (all self-build applications); Construction Environmental Management Plan (major development not on an industrial estate); Glint and Glare Assessment (all solar farms).
issues.evidence: Validation Checklist Adopted July 2025, Section 3 items 1-41 (e.g. item 3 Affordable Housing Statement, item 26 Social Value Strategy, item 39 CEMP, item 40 Glint and Glare)

issues.detail: Householder, Outline, Demolition in conservation area, Minerals & waste and others are marked '(none)', but the list applies requirements to them. Householder: Tree Survey applies to householder schemes in a Conservation Area or near TPO trees; Flood Risk Assessment applies to all new development in Flood Zones 2/3 including minor; Heritage Impact Assessment, Materials and Parking/access details also apply. Demolition in a CA: Photographs and Scheme for Site Treatment and Management Plan. Minerals & waste: Operations Statement/Restoration & Aftercare Plan, Waste Assessment, Coal Mining Risk Assessment. Outline: most threshold-based items (Transport Assessment, FRA, Air Quality, HIA, Affordable Housing, Social Value) are not limited to full applications.
issues.evidence: Item 31 Tree Survey: 'excluding householder development outside a Conservation Area or near TPO trees'; item 19: 'All minerals applications'; item 25: 'All applications including demolition'

issues.detail: Almost every requirement (Air Quality, Arboricultural, BNG, Contaminated Land, DAS, Ecology, Levels, FRA, HIA, Heritage, Highways, LVIA, Noise, Parking, Retail, Telecoms, Transport, Ventilation, Waste) is placed under 'Full planning' only, with the note 'INFERRED: application type not named ... placed under Full planning'. The list applies them by development trigger, not by application type. Listed building consent shows only Structural Survey, yet Heritage Impact Assessment, Photographs and Materials are also triggered by listed building works.
issues.evidence: Item 21 Photographs: 'Listed Building works (including internal)'; item 18 Materials: 'development ... affecting Listed Buildings'

issues.detail: Many trigger excerpts are fragments from the wrong row or boilerplate, not the real trigger. Arboricultural: 'damage and arboriculturist's report if the work required relates to the condition of the tree. 35.' (this is from Works to Trees; real trigger is trees on or adjacent to the site). Ecological: 'undertake an ecology survey ... 1.10 We want to make the planning process as clear as possible' (real trigger: on/adjacent to designated sites, habitats, bat-roost buildings). Noise and Transport Assessment both use 'Assessments and Noise Assessments) should include an analysis of each use' (a mixed-use note, not a trigger). LVIA: 'Guidelines for Landscape and Visual Assessment.. 16.' Levels: 'Information should include spot levels...' (content, not trigger). DAS trigger is copied from the Heritage row. HIA: garbled note instead of the thresholds (over 50 dwellings, commercial over 1,000 sq m, major public buildings).
issues.evidence: Item 12 HIA: residential over 50 units; commercial/industrial over 1,000 sq m; all new major public buildings and community facilities

issues.detail: Highways, Parking, Waste/Refuse and Ventilation excerpts are scrambled text from merged table columns (e.g. 'All applications where parking/access Information will include details of the are required to be part of the existing/proposed proposal'). The FRA trigger leaves out Flood Zones 2/3 (all new development including minor and change of use), sub-1 ha sites with critical drainage problems, and the rule that all major development needs a Sustainable Drainage Strategy and pro-forma. The BNG trigger leaves out the exemptions list (householder, self-build of 9 or fewer dwellings on 0.5 ha or less, de minimis). The Telecoms trigger leaves out the alternative-sites and 3 km Liverpool John Lennon Airport notification rules.
issues.evidence: Item 10 Flood Risk: 'Flood Zones 2 and 3 ... all new development including minor and change of use'; item 41 BNG exemptions

issues.detail: 'Planning Obligations / S106 draft Heads of Terms' and 'Ground investigation / Geotechnical / Basement Impact Assessment' come from the SuDS Pro-Forma 1 (a drainage declaration form), not the local list. The S106 text refers to securing SuDS maintenance, and the geotechnical text is a SuDS soil-permeability evidence line. Neither is a standalone local validation requirement.
issues.evidence: Pro-Forma 1: 'entering into a Section 106 agreement ... Statement provided within your Sustainable Drainage Strategy'

issues.detail: Most tab_items are process text, boilerplate or fragments rather than requirements: 'It would be appreciated if the scale of the plans ... 2.2'; 'You are required to use our Checklist ... 1.11 Upon receipt'; the 14/28-day withdrawal rule; 'Validation Dispute 1.17 We want to avoid disputes'; 'Hard copies of applications must be posted to the Council at the following address:'; 'Applicants are encouraged to supply ... pdf format'; 'LCR_Mandatory_BNG_Guidance_Note_FINAL.pdf (merseysidebiobank.org.uk).'; 'Planning for Air Quality. air-qualityplanningguidance.pdf.'. 'GIS layers in table file format...' is a BNG detail cut out of its context.

Block plan / Site plan, Floor plans / Elevations and Roof plan are national plan requirements taken from the phrase 'show the site plan, floorplans, elevations and roof plans'. They are not local list items.
issues.evidence: Trigger excerpt 'show the site plan, floorplans, elevations and roof plans.'

issues.detail: Highways/access, Parking provision and Waste/Refuse storage are three rows built from the same single local item, 'Parking, Access, Deliveries and Refuse Details' (item 20). Design and Access Statement and Heritage Statement share the same excerpt.
issues.evidence: Item 20: 'All applications where parking/access are required to be part of the proposal'

issues.detail: The document is titled 'Adopted July 2025', but para 1.16 still calls it a 'draft Local Validation Checklist' for consultation. Grokbot's date is correct, but this wording is worth a caveat.
issues.evidence: Para 1.16 refers to the 'draft Local Validation Checklist'

summary: Grokbot's link is the current Knowsley list (Adopted July 2025) and the date is right. The extraction is poor: more than half of the 41 local requirements are missing, many triggers are garbled or taken from the wrong row, and requirements are put under the wrong application types, with Householder, Minerals and Demolition wrongly shown as having none.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
